settings.title: Protect the people, devices and access your business runs on

Devices and identities aren’t treated as separate problems. Folio3 connects endpoint monitoring, Microsoft 365 security, access controls, privileged access monitoring and posture reviews, so risks are spotted and protection gets stronger across your whole user environment.

settings.title: Why managing devices isn’t the same as securing them

settings.editor: Managing devices and user accounts keeps your environment running. It doesn’t give you the visibility to spot suspicious endpoint activity, excessive permissions, compromised identities or risky admin access.
An endpoint security service adds security-focused monitoring, assessment and controls around the technology your users rely on every day.
The two work best together, but they solve different problems.

settings.title: Security expertise that covers users, devices and beyond

settings.editor: Endpoint security doesn’t exist apart from the rest of your environment. Folio3 brings security, Microsoft, infrastructure, identity and managed IT expertise together to tackle risk across your whole user environment.
Find gaps across devices, endpoint controls, configurations and suspicious activity.

Improve visibility into elevated access and find areas that need tighter oversight.
Why teams choose Folio3’s endpoint security service

settings.title: Endpoint and identity security backed by broader technology expertise

settings.editor: Endpoint and identity risks are closely linked. A compromised device can expose an identity, and a compromised account can open your business systems.
Folio3 combines security and technology expertise to understand both risks in the context of your Microsoft 365 environment, applications, infrastructure, access controls and business operations.
Strengthen protection across users, devices, identities, and access with security controls designed to reduce unauthorized access and endpoint-based risks.
